icon_file.label: Custom icon
icon_file.description: An SVG or PNG to use instead of the glyph. Edits to the file appear in the bar straight away.

icon_file_active.label: Custom icon, gamer mode on
icon_file_active.description: Shown while gamer mode is on. A custom icon cannot be recoloured, so without this the state is only in the tooltip.

click_action.label: Left-click action
click_action.description: What left-clicking the bar icon does. Right-click always toggles gamer mode.

profile.label: Gamer mode profile
profile.description: How aggressive the suspend list is.

auto_performance.label: Auto performance profile
auto_performance.description: Switch power profile to performance while gamer mode is on.

show_temps.label: Show temperatures
show_temps.description: Include CPU/GPU temperatures in tooltip and panel.

targets.label: Suspend targets (JSON)
targets.description: Advanced: JSON array of {match, kind, profiles}. Kind: process, user-service, system-service, container.

show_cpu.label: CPU usage
show_cpu.description: Show processor load in the bar.

show_glyphs.label: Icons
show_glyphs.description: Show an icon beside each reading. Off gives numbers only.

label_min_width.label: Reserved value width
label_min_width.description: Pixels to reserve for each reading. Zero lets every value hug its text, so the readout is as wide as it needs to be. Raise it if you would rather the width held steady than stayed tight.

highlight_gamer_mode.label: Highlight while gamer mode is on
highlight_gamer_mode.description: Tints the readout instead of adding an icon, so nothing moves when it switches.

flame.label: Flame
flame.description: Burns while gamer mode is on, as hot as the machine is working. "Always" keeps it animating the whole session, which costs CPU while you play.

flame_style.label: Flame style
flame_style.description: How the flame is drawn. "Graph" is one node and the cheapest; "bars" is crisper up close and costs 28.

flame_height.label: Flame height
flame_height.description: Height of the flame band in pixels. The band is mirrored by an equal space above it so the readings stay centred, so it can only be half of whatever the pill has spare. Raise the bar's capsule thickness for a taller flame.

notify.session_failed: The session file could not be written, so nothing was suspended.

cleanup.title: Maintenance
cleanup.swap_unknown: Swap usage could not be read.
cleanup.swap_no_room: Not enough free RAM to hold what is swapped out.
cleanup.failed: That did not work. See the log.
